name: Name
name_hint: Letters, digits, _ and -. You pick it by this name in model configuration.
kind_api_hint: The hub calls this API directly (for uses like translation and triage).
kind_launcher_hint: Runs as Claude Code (main chat, Agents).
url_official_hint: The official Anthropic API. Usually no need to change it.
url_responses_hint: Base URL of a Responses-compatible API.
url_gateway_hint: Base URL of an Anthropic Messages-compatible gateway, without /v1.
auth_bearer_hint: Authorization: Bearer (ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN). Most gateways use this.
auth_key_hint: x-api-key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). The official Anthropic API uses this.
key_hint: Stored encrypted on the hub and never returned by the API.
responses_note: The Responses protocol can't be tested or list models here. Add models by hand in the next step.
test_cost: Testing sends one 1-token request, which may cost a little.
discover_failed: Couldn't fetch the model list: {error}. You can add models by hand in the next step.
discover_found_one: Found {count} model. Check it in the next step.
discover_found_other: Found {count} models. Check them in the next step.
advanced_badge: Tier models, subagents, headers, proxy, timeout, context
official_detail: api.anthropic.com, with an API Key from the Anthropic Console.
custom_detail: A relay, a company gateway, or a Messages-compatible service such as GLM, Kimi or DeepSeek.
no_models: No models yet. Use "Fetch models" in the previous step, or add them by hand below.
subagent_hint: For multi-agent runs such as workflows.
force_label: Force subagents to use this model
headers_set: Set (hidden). Typing new ones replaces them all.
headers_hint: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS. Stored encrypted like the key and not shown again.
custom_model_hint: Adds one more choice to /model. A description needs a name.
args_hint: Added after claude, separated by spaces, each starting with -.
extension_note: The URL, connection type and models come from the extension "{plugin}". Once added, you can edit it like one you filled in yourself.
key_hint_with: {hint} Stored encrypted on the hub and never returned by the API.
preset_models_error: Couldn't read the extension's model list ({error}). These are the ones it declares.
default_model_hint: Each use's choice is managed in "Model configuration". This default applies when none is set.
